newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sony declines to confirm Brussels assembly centre.
newsitem.headline: Sony declines to confirm Brussels assembly centre.

text.p: Sony Corp said on Monday it could not confirm recent media reports that it would set up a laptop assembly and distribution centre in Brussels.

"We did not make such an announcement. This could just be speculation," said a spokeswoman for the Japanese consumer electronics giant. "I have not heard of something like that, so we cannot confirm this."
Earlier, Belgian media reported that Sony was close to setting up a distribution and assembly centre in Brussels.
The centre would assemble laptops from parts made in Asia, the reports said.

They also said that the operation would be part of Sony's efforts to break into the European computer market, after last month's launch of a notebook computer and last year's launch of a home PC, both in the United States.
Brussels region minister Jos Chabert was quoted as saying a final decision by the company was imminent, the reports said.
